annotations.title: Get the project the user has open

description: Use only when the user asks to work on their open project or selection. Return lightweight context from an authorized editor active in the last 2 minutes. Never choose a recent or unrelated project. General questions about Berrys do not need this tool. Does not open or render a canvas; use playground_canvas_open only when a preview is requested or needed for the task. Returns whether editor context exists and, when available, the current project and selection.
name: playground_context_current
